gui.me_rebalancer.scope_help: Cycle All items / Whitelist / Blacklist. Whitelist moves only listed items; Blacklist moves everything except listed items. Changes apply immediately.
gui.me_rebalancer.clear_help: Remove all filters; keep the current filter mode and run state.
gui.me_rebalancer.choose_items: Add whitelist items or change mode
gui.me_rebalancer.filter_help: Click to copy; right-click to clear
gui.me_rebalancer.test_help: Pause this Rebalancer and estimate item routes without moving items or using transfer energy. Hover over preview items for full amounts and destination details.
gui.me_rebalancer.preview_unavailable: Needs valid scope, online grid, empty buffer
gui.me_rebalancer.preview_failed: Preview stopped; check grid or server log
gui.me_rebalancer.preview_stale: Settings or storage changed; refresh preview
preview.me_rebalancer.estimate_help: Conservative estimate, not a reservation. Independent drawer/slot capacity can be underestimated. Other automation may change actual transfers.
